desc:
Deep Space Tycoon: Reborn

A continuation of the original Deep Space Tycoon, rebuilt and expanded with new systems, fixes, and content. Terraform dead planets, fight off aliens, and grow your tycoon.

Current Max Rebirth: 5.

Built with love and full credit to biggranny and the original DST team, whose game inspired all of this. The original is no longer available on Roblox.
